Actual keyable background perfectly flat magenta #FF00FF, NO gradient, shadow, floor, checkerboard, stars, motionlines, glow, VFX, text or labels. ONLY Naruto Uzumaki, original orange jumpsuit with navy blue shoulders, cream collar, blue headband, short blond spikes, blue sandals. Teen proportions exactly like orange reference.
